name: Face
description: Face presets: scale factors on the neutral head's features (tools/blender/anatomy.py, add_head). 1.0 is neutral. brow: brow ridge; jaw: jaw width; cheek: cheekbones; nose: nose size; bridge: nose bridge width and hump; chin: chin size; lips: fullness; hollow: cheek hollows under the cheekbones; eyes: eye size.
